seed_schedule: SHA256(master_seed|effect_label|N|replicate|choice_set_id), first 64 bits interpreted as unsigned integer

estimator.parameterization: three within-profile action-logit differences per surface/profile relative to fixed reference action 0, plus declared nuisance terms
estimator.primary_contrast: mean over 24 frozen permutations × 4 profiles of [d_F(p,pi(p))-d_F(p,p)] - [d_S(p,pi(p))-d_S(p,p)], with d_s(p,0)=0
estimator.covariance: model-based covariance from the declared estimator
estimator.rejection_rule: two-sided Wald test of primary contrast at alpha=0.05

controls.SURFACE_CONTROL: control analysis; no primary future-linked signal
controls.UNINFORMATIVE_NULL: control analysis; no informative future-linked signal
